input: Get a quote for a whole-house water filtration system

gold.taskTitle: Get a whole-house water filtration system quote
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to obtain a price quote for installing a whole-house water filtration system in their home.

questions.title: Do you own or rent your home?
questions.description: Ownership status affects whether the user can install a permanent system and who is responsible for the decision.

questions.title: What specific water problem are you trying to solve?
questions.description: Understanding the problem (hard water, chlorine taste, sediment, contaminants, etc.) determines what type of filtration system is needed.

questions.title: Have you had your water tested recently?
questions.description: A recent water test report would tell providers exactly what contaminants to filter, leading to a more accurate quote.

questions.title: How many bathrooms and people are in the home?
questions.description: Household size and water usage volume determine the required system capacity and flow rate.

questions.title: Are you on city water or a private well?
questions.description: The water source significantly changes the type of filtration system recommended and its cost.

questions.title: Do you want installation included in the quote?
questions.description: Some users want equipment-only pricing while others want a full installed price from a plumber or specialist.

questions.title: How many quotes from different providers do you want?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user wants one quote or multiple competing quotes shapes how many vendors to contact.
